messages:
Alex K.: Heads up — candidate Samira R. moved to 3pm PT tomorrow (was 11am ET). Need cover for the interviewer slot or a swap. Calendar: https://calendar.app/evt/abc123 — PT timezone. Also need a scribe and someone to lead the 5–10m debrief right after. Who can take 3:00–4:00pm PT?
Priya S.: I can scribe and take notes. I'll add the notes template to the event. @Jordan L. are you good to interview at 3:00 PT?
Jordan L.: I can do 3:00–3:30 PT. After that I have another meeting. If someone can take the 3:30–4:00 slot that works.
Samir Patel: I can pick up 3:30–4:00 PT and lead the debrief (3:55–4:05). Happy to call out highlights and recs.
Riley M.: Quick rubric question — are we using the updated 1–4 scale (competency/impact/communication) or the old 1–5? I want to make sure my scoring maps to the normalization sheet.
Priya S.: Use the new 1–4 scale (standard now). I'll paste rubric + scoring steps into the calendar note. Quick steps:
```
1) Open the "Interview Scores" sheet in the event doc
2) Enter 1–4 per category (technical, product sense, communication, role fit)
3) Add 1 line of evidence for any score <=2 or >=4
4) Set "Scribe" cell to your initials when notes are done
```
Jordan L.: Great — thanks. Also small ask: can we add a line in the event description: "No compensation negotiation in interview; redirect to recruiting"? Candidate brought it up in pre-screen.
Priya S.: Done — updated description and pinged Recruiting to take any compensation questions. Also added scribe template and rubric links.
CalendarBot: Event updated — attendees notified and timezone adjusted to PT.
Alex K.: Awesome, thanks everyone. Summary: Jordan 3:00–3:30, Samir 3:30–4:00, Priya scribing, Samir debrief lead 3:55–4:05. I'll drop a quick message to candidate confirming. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Yep all set. I'll prepare 2–3 targeted questions on system design given role.
Jordan L.: Perfect. If anything changes, ping here or DM.
Alex K.: Perfect — closing the loop. Thanks all!
